sources.use: Checked first: this HKBWS Avifauna route returns only the generic Species Accounts shell and has no Velvet Scoter species account; it is not treated as a source for identification or Hong Kong status.

Cornell eBird species profile read: male is darker with a small white mark below the eye, yellow bill with dark knob and white wing speculum; female is browner with two rounded pale head patches; breeding in northern European woodland/tundra wetlands and winter mainly coastal.
BirdLife International 2020 global IUCN assessment: Vulnerable; estimated three-generation decline 30–46%. IUCN status is global and does not indicate Hong Kong frequency.
Full page read for Black Scoter comparison: adult male all dark with no white wing patch, large orange-yellow bill-base knob; one Hong Kong record at Mai Po in 2007; global IUCN Near Threatened.
